evaluations.reality: Uralic actually has approximately 15 tasks, not 25. The claim overestimates the value by 66%, which is a significant misrepresentation of the bar length.

evaluations.claim: IE-Baltic (light pink) and IE-other (red) exhibit comparable task counts, each hovering near 18 tasks, with IE-Baltic marginally exceeding IE-other.
evaluations.reality: IE-Baltic has approximately 12 tasks, while IE-other has around 15 tasks. IE-other actually exceeds IE-Baltic, not the other way around, reversing the true comparison.
evaluations.reason: Description states 17 and 15 tasks, no comparison.

evaluations.claim: IE-Germanic (light green) stabilizes at around 40 tasks.
evaluations.reality: IE-Germanic has approximately 45 tasks, not 40. The use of 'stabilizes' also misleadingly implies a plateau or leveling off, which is not supported by the data.
